title: High confidence Motex Landscope service spawning shell or LOLBin - STRICT
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects Landscope MR/DA service processes spawning shells or LOLBins after possible CVE-2025-61932 compromise. Shell interpreters (cmd, powershell) require a suspicious CLI indicator. High-risk LOLBins (mshta, rundll32, certutil, msiexec, etc.) trigger without CLI requirement because being spawned from MR/DA is already high-confidence post-exploitation.
